reason: A client plugin that adds and persists a Dracula theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, including theme selection in Settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加 Dracula 深色主题、主题切换设置页及本地主题偏好持久化。
summaries.en: Adds a Dracula dark theme, theme-switching settings page, and local preference persistence to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

capabilities: Registers a Dracula theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Overrides UI color and syntax-highlighting CSS tokens
Adds a Themes settings page for switching themes
Persists the selected theme in localStorage
